title: Topic 1 食事
japanese_text: A：なんか煙くない？\nB：<ruby>確<rt>たし</rt></ruby>かに…あ、焦げてる！この<ruby>黒<rt>くろ</rt></ruby>い<u>塊</u>、<ruby>何<rt>なに</rt></ruby>？\nA：うーん…たぶん、ホルモン…。
english_translation: A: Can't you smell smoke? B: I sure can... Oh, it's burning! What are these black chunks? A: Hmmm... it's probably offal...
